# neat tool reference

neat gives Claude 267 tools. You don't call them yourself: ask Claude in plain language and it picks the tools it needs. This page is for when you want to know exactly what neat can do. Tools that need a character's permission list the scope group they need in their error when it's missing; see the main [README](../../README.md#choosing-what-neat-can-see).

## Characters and login

Log characters in, choose what each one lets neat see, record which EVE account each is on and notes about it, and log them out.

- `add_character`: Log in EVE Online characters via ESI OAuth2. Opens the user's browser at EVE's login page; afterwards the browser shows a neat page listing their characters, where they can log in more characters before clicking Done or closing the tab. Blocks until then and returns every character added, with the scope groups each granted. Every login grants the basic scope group plus scopeGroups: before calling, ask the user what they'll use neat for, including whether they want their corporation's data, and pick groups from list_scope_groups (or use only basic if they don't know). A login replaces each character's access with exactly what it requested, so to add a group to characters already logged in, either pass characterId or list every group they should end up with; list_characters doesn't show a character's current groups, so if you don't know them, pass characterId. If no browser tab opens, the user can open http://127.0.0.1:48211/ themselves while the tool waits. To grant more groups to a character later (e.g. after a tool fails because a scope is missing), pass its characterId: its existing scopes are kept. Check the result's warnings: they say when the user logged in as a different character, or when the character's earlier scope groups couldn't be read and may need granting again. Re-adding a known character refreshes its login.
- `list_characters`: List EVE Online characters currently logged in to neat, with the account label and notes the user gave each. Characters with the same account label are on the same EVE account and can't be logged in at the same time. Its warnings name characters whose account is unknown: ask the user and save the answer with update_character_details.
- `list_scope_groups`: List the scope groups add_character can grant a character: each group's name, what it lets neat do, and its ESI scopes. The basic group is always granted.
- `remove_character`: Remove a logged-in EVE Online character, deleting its stored credentials.
- `update_character_details`: Record what the user tells you about their characters: which EVE account each is on (an account label shared by the characters on that account), and notes on what a character is for. Also renames an account label for every character that has it. Ask about accounts whenever list_characters or add_character warns that one is unknown, and save notes the user gives you. Returns every value changed, old and new, so you can tell the user what was saved. Writes to ~/.neat/characters.yaml only.

## Game client

Act on the running EVE client: set autopilot waypoints and open in-game windows.

- `open_contract_window`: Open a contract window on the given character's live EVE client — this changes what's displayed on the character's screen.
- `open_information_window`: Open an information window on the given character's live EVE client — this changes what's displayed on the character's screen.
- `open_market_details_window`: Open a market details window on the given character's live EVE client — this changes what's displayed on the character's screen.
- `open_new_mail_window`: Open a pre-filled new mail window on the given character's live EVE client — this changes what's displayed on the character's screen.
- `set_autopilot_waypoint`: Set an autopilot waypoint on the given character's live EVE client — this changes the character's active autopilot route.

## Navigation and hauling

Jump and gate routes with fuel, fatigue and dotlan links, saved routes with your notes, and cargo packed into loads, for any move: PvP, PvE or industry. Haul profiles and routes are saved in `~/.neat/haul_profiles.yaml` and `~/.neat/routes.yaml`, which you can also edit.

- `delete_haul_profile`: Delete a saved haul profile from neat's local config.
- `delete_route`: Delete a saved jump route from ~/.neat/routes.yaml.
- `list_haul_profiles`: List saved haul profiles.
- `list_routes`: List saved jump routes with their systems, ship class and the user's notes. Check it before planning a route between the same places.
- `plan_haul`: Pack a cargo list into loads for a haul profile's hold, each an even slice with volume by drop-off, plus round-trip route, fuel per trip, and a Multibuy list per load including fuel.
- `plan_jump_route`: Plan jump and gate routes between two systems for a haul profile's ship and pilot, applying their routing preferences, or validate and cost a given route; per leg light years, fuel and fatigue, and dotlan links that display each route.
- `save_haul_profile`: Save (or replace) a named hauling profile: hull, pilot, fitted hold, optional pinned routes (saved in routes.yaml, or saved routes by name), and routing preferences (avoid lists, sovereignty and standings, midpoints, optimise for fuel, jumps or fatigue). Omit notes to keep the notes it has. Writes to ~/.neat/haul_profiles.yaml and routes.yaml only.
- `save_route`: Save (or replace) a named jump route: its systems in order, the kind of ship it's for, and the user's notes on why it goes that way. Check list_routes before planning a route between the same places, since a saved route usually reflects choices the user made on purpose. plan_jump_route costs a saved route by name, and haul profiles pin saved routes for their regular runs. Returns every value it changed. Writes to ~/.neat/routes.yaml only.

## Stations and structures you use

The NPC stations and Upwell structures you work from, with what the game won't tell neat: what you use each for, whether it has a working clone bay and how that's known, and your notes. Saved in `~/.neat/structures.yaml`, which you can also edit.

- `delete_structure`: Delete a saved station or structure from ~/.neat/structures.yaml.
- `list_structures`: List the NPC stations and Upwell structures the user works from (~/.neat/structures.yaml), with what the game won't tell neat: what they use each for, whether it has a working clone bay and how that's known, their corporation offices, and their notes. Each call checks every logged-in character's jump clones and records any clone bay they prove; a clone bay neat can't prove stays unknown, and only the user can check it in game. Pass characterIds to check, live, which characters have docking access to each Upwell structure. Use it before planning a clone jump, a staging move or anything that needs to dock somewhere.
- `save_structure`: Save an NPC station or Upwell structure the user works from, or update one. Its name, type, system and owner are filled in from the game (an Upwell structure needs a character with docking access the first time). Record what the user tells you: what they use it for, its facility profile, a clone bay they checked in game (cloneBay yes or no), and notes. Offer to save a location whenever a plan uses one that isn't saved yet. Returns every value it changed, old and new, so you can tell the user what was recorded. Writes to ~/.neat/structures.yaml only.

## Trade hubs and purchases

Trade hubs to buy at, and shopping lists priced against a hub's live order book. Hub profiles are saved in `~/.neat/config.json`.

- `list_hub_profiles`: List saved trade hub profiles and the default (Jita 4-4).
- `quote_market_purchase`: Price a shopping list against a trade hub's live sell order book, walking depth for the full quantity; returns average and total per item, shortfalls, volume, and an in-game Multibuy list.
- `save_hub_profile`: Save (or replace) a named trade hub (region and station) to buy at. Writes to ~/.neat/config.json only.

## Industry planning

Build plans, build-or-buy, job costs, research and invention, and refining and compressed ore. Facility profiles are saved in `~/.neat/facilities.yaml`, which you can also edit.

- `calibrate_facility_profile`: Read a real industry job's charged fee, back out the effective fee rate, and save it on a facility profile so later estimates use it. Writes to ~/.neat/facilities.yaml only.
- `check_build_skills`: For each character, show manufacturing, reaction and science slots, skill time multipliers, and which items in a product's build tree they can build or which skills they lack.
- `check_material_stock`: Net a list of materials against what a character or corporation holds at a station or structure (optionally one hangar division), with the volume of stock used.
- `delete_facility_profile`: Delete a saved facility profile from neat's local config.
- `describe_facility`: Show a facility profile's security band and every material, time and cost multiplier with its source, and optionally, for a product, the combined multipliers and whether each activity can run there.
- `estimate_invention`: For a T2 item, estimate invention chance, output copy (runs, ME, TE) and expected cost per success and per run for no decryptor and each decryptor, with a character's skills and hub prices.
- `estimate_job_cost`: Estimate a manufacturing or reaction job's installation fee at a facility profile: estimated item value, cost index, structure bonus, taxes, or the profile's calibrated rate.
- `estimate_reprocessing_yield`: Reprocessing yield per ore category for a character at a facility profile (NPC station or Upwell), counting skills, structure, rigs, security and the character's implant, plus the tax.
- `estimate_research`: Estimate ME research, TE research or copying time and fee for a blueprint at a facility profile with a character's skills.
- `find_owned_blueprints`: Find a character's or corporation's blueprints by product or name, with ME, TE, runs, whether each is tied up in an active job, the station or structure it's in and any named container, plus per-blueprint totals.
- `list_facility_profiles`: List saved facility profiles.
- `plan_build`: Plan building owned blueprints end to end: expand the build tree with your copies' ME and the facility's bonuses, net stock, price purchases on live order books, optionally buy compressed ore and refine it, compare building against buying every intermediate, price job fees, pack haul loads with fuel and dotlan route links, and estimate job time across builders. Returns cost, decisions, shopping and Multibuy lists, loads, jobs and assumptions, and saves the full plan under ~/.neat/plans/.
- `save_facility_profile`: Save (or replace) a named industry or reprocessing facility profile in neat's local config: NPC station, Upwell structure or starbase, its system, fitted rigs and services, and owner-set taxes. Rig and structure bonuses are read from the SDE; the response shows every resolved multiplier. Writes to ~/.neat/facilities.yaml only; omit notes to keep the notes it has.
- `solve_ore_mix`: Find the cheapest mix of compressed ore and refined minerals at a hub to cover a mineral need, counting the refiner's yield, freight per m³ and live order-book depth; returns purchases, refined output, surplus, byproducts and a Multibuy list.

## Universe and static data

Items, ships, systems, regions, stations, dogma attributes and gate routes. Most of this is answered from the local SDE copy without calling ESI.

- `get_dogma_attribute`: Get detail for one dogma attribute (public data, no character required).
- `get_dogma_dynamic_item`: Get detail for one mutated ("abyssal") item, identified by its source type and item ID (public data, no character required).
- `get_dogma_effect`: Get detail for one dogma effect (public data, no character required).
- `get_route`: Compute a route between two solar systems, optionally avoiding systems or adding extra connections (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_asteroid_belt`: Get an asteroid belt's name, position, and solar system (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_category`: Get an item category's name, published state, and member group IDs (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_constellation`: Get a constellation's name, region, position, and member system IDs (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_graphic`: Get a graphic's collision/graphic files, icon folder, and Space Object Factory (SOF) DNA/hull/race/faction names (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_group`: Get an item group's name, category, published state, and member type IDs (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_moon`: Get a moon's name, position, and solar system (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_planet`: Get a planet's name, type, position, and solar system (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_region`: Get a region's name, description, and member constellation IDs (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_star`: Get a star's age, luminosity, name, radius, solar system, spectral class, temperature, and type (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_stargate`: Get a stargate's name, type, position, solar system, and destination (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_station`: Get a station's name, type, position, solar system, owner, services, and docking/reprocessing stats (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_structure`: Get a player structure's name, owner, solar system, type, and position. The given character must have docking access to the structure.
- `get_universe_system`: Get a solar system's name, constellation, position, security status/class, star, stargates, stations, and planets (public data, no character required).
- `get_universe_type`: Get an item type's full detail: name, group, dogma attributes/effects, and physical stats (public data, no character required).
- `list_dogma_attributes`: List every dogma attribute ID currently defined (public data, no character required).
- `list_dogma_effects`: List every dogma effect ID currently defined (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_ancestries`: List every character ancestry (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_bloodlines`: List every character bloodline (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_categories`: List every item category ID (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_constellations`: List every constellation ID (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_factions`: List every NPC faction (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_graphics`: List every graphic ID (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_groups`: List every item group ID, paginated (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_races`: List every character race (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_regions`: List every region ID (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_structures`: List every publicly-listed player structure ID (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_system_jumps`: List ship jump activity per solar system over the last hour (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_system_kills`: List NPC/pod/ship kill activity per solar system over the last hour (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_systems`: List every solar system ID (public data, no character required).
- `list_universe_types`: List every item type ID, paginated (public data, no character required).
- `resolve_universe_ids`: Resolve a list of names to IDs, grouped by category: agents, alliances, characters, constellations, corporations, factions, inventory types, regions, stations, and systems. Names ESI can't match are simply omitted from the response, not reported as errors. Accepts 1-500 names per call (public data, no character required).
- `resolve_universe_names`: Resolve a list of IDs to their names and categories. Accepts 1-1000 IDs per call (public data, no character required).

## Wallet

Character and corporation wallets.

- `get_wallet_balance`: Get a logged-in EVE Online character's current ISK wallet balance.
- `list_character_wallet_journal`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's wallet journal entries (ISK gains/losses with reasons), paginated.
- `list_character_wallet_transactions`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's market wallet transactions (buys/sells), newest first.
- `list_corporation_wallet_journal`: List a corporation wallet division's journal entries, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_wallet_transactions`: List a corporation wallet division's market transactions, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_wallets`: List a corporation's wallet division balances, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.

## Assets

What characters and corporations own, and where.

- `get_asset_locations`: Resolve a set of a character's asset item IDs into their positions.
- `get_asset_names`: Resolve a set of a character's asset item IDs into their player-assigned custom names.
- `get_corporation_asset_locations`: Resolve a set of a corporation's asset item IDs into their positions.
- `get_corporation_asset_names`: Resolve a set of a corporation's asset item IDs into their player-assigned custom names.
- `list_assets`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's assets.
- `list_corporation_assets`: List a corporation's assets, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_location_assets`: List everything the user owns at one NPC station or Upwell structure, across every logged-in character (and a corporation's hangars, through a character with the roles), in one call instead of paging list_assets. Items are listed in tree order with what's inside each container and ship, and every volume comes worked out: each stack's volume as it is now, assembled ships' assembled and repackaged volumes, what comes out of each ship to repackage it, and the rigs that repackaging destroys. Totals give the volume to move with ships repackaged or carried assembled. Use it whenever a plan moves things out of a station or structure.

## Market, contracts and loyalty points

Market orders and prices, contracts, insurance and LP stores.

- `get_market_group`: Get detail for one market group, including its item types (public data, no character required).
- `get_market_history`: Get daily historical market statistics for one item type in one region (public data, no character required).
- `list_character_contract_bids`: List the bids on one of a logged-in character's contracts.
- `list_character_contract_items`: List the items on one of a logged-in character's contracts.
- `list_character_contracts`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's contracts.
- `list_character_loyalty_points`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's loyalty point balances with every corporation they've worked for.
- `list_character_market_order_history`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's cancelled/expired market orders from the last 90 days.
- `list_character_market_orders`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's open market orders.
- `list_corporation_contract_bids`: List the bids on one of a corporation's contracts, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_contract_items`: List the items on one of a corporation's contracts, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_contracts`: List a corporation's contracts, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_market_order_history`: List a corporation's cancelled/expired market orders from the last 90 days, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_market_orders`: List a corporation's open market orders, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_insurance_prices`: List insurance price levels for every insurable ship type (public data, no character required).
- `list_loyalty_store_offers`: List a corporation's loyalty store offers (public data, no character required).
- `list_market_groups`: List every market group ID in the game (public data, no character required).
- `list_market_orders`: List live market orders in a region, optionally filtered to one item type (public data, no character required).
- `list_market_prices`: List ESI's adjusted/average price for every priced item type in the game (public data, no character required).
- `list_market_types`: List the item type IDs with at least one active market order in a region (public data, no character required).
- `list_public_contract_bids`: List the bids on a public contract (public data, no character required).
- `list_public_contract_items`: List the items on a public contract (public data, no character required).
- `list_public_contracts`: List public contracts in a region (public data, no character required).
- `list_structure_market_orders`: List live market orders in a player structure, using a logged-in character's docking access to authorize.

## Killmails and warfare

Killmails, wars, faction warfare, sovereignty campaigns, incursions and military campaigns.

- `get_character_fw_stats`: Get a logged-in EVE Online character's faction warfare stats.
- `get_character_military_campaign_objective_participation`: Get a logged-in character's contribution to and commitment status in one military campaign objective.
- `get_corporation_fw_stats`: Get a corporation's faction warfare stats, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `get_fw_character_leaderboards`: Get the top pilot rankings by kills and victory points (public data, no character required).
- `get_fw_corporation_leaderboards`: Get the top corporation rankings by kills and victory points (public data, no character required).
- `get_fw_leaderboards`: Get the top faction rankings by kills and victory points (public data, no character required).
- `get_killmail`: Get the full details of a killmail, given its ID and hash (public data, no character required).
- `get_military_campaign`: Get one military campaign's state, progress, and start/finish times (public data, no character required).
- `get_military_campaign_objective`: Get one military campaign objective's state, progress, and participant counts (public data, no character required).
- `get_war`: Get a war's aggressor/defender/allies, declared/started/retracted/finished times, and mutual/open-for-allies flags (public data, no character required).
- `list_character_killmails_recent`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's recent killmail references.
- `list_character_military_campaign_objectives`: List the military campaign objectives a logged-in character has participated in, with contribution and commitment, cursor-paginated.
- `list_corporation_killmails_recent`: List a corporation's recent killmail references, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_fw_stats`: List every faction's faction warfare stats (public data, no character required).
- `list_fw_systems`: List every solar system's faction warfare occupation/contest state (public data, no character required).
- `list_fw_wars`: List every faction warfare declaration (public data, no character required).
- `list_incursions`: List every currently active incursion (public data, no character required).
- `list_military_campaign_objectives`: List a military campaign's objectives with progress and participant counts, cursor-paginated (public data, no character required).
- `list_military_campaigns`: List EVE Online military campaigns with their state, progress, and start/finish times (public data, no character required).
- `list_sovereignty_campaigns`: List every active sovereignty campaign in the game (public data, no character required).
- `list_sovereignty_systems`: List every solar system and its current sovereignty claim, if any (public data, no character required).
- `list_war_killmails`: List killmail references for a war, paginated (public data, no character required).
- `list_wars`: List war IDs, optionally only those older than a given war ID (public data, no character required).

## Mail, calendar, contacts and notifications

EVE mail, calendar events, contact lists and notifications.

- `add_character_contacts`: Add contacts to a character's contact list with a given standing — this creates new contacts on EVE's server.
- `create_character_mail_label`: Create a new mail label for a logged-in EVE Online character. This changes state on EVE's server.
- `delete_character_mail`: Delete one of a logged-in EVE Online character's mails. This changes state on EVE's server.
- `delete_character_mail_label`: Delete one of a logged-in EVE Online character's mail labels. This changes state on EVE's server.
- `get_calendar_event`: Get detail (date, duration, owner, description, RSVP status) for one calendar event.
- `get_character_mail`: Get the full body and recipients of one of a logged-in EVE Online character's mails.
- `get_character_mail_labels`: Get a logged-in EVE Online character's mail labels and unread counts.
- `list_alliance_contact_labels`: List an alliance's contact labels, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_alliance_contacts`: List an alliance's contacts, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_calendar_event_attendees`: List the attendees and their RSVP status for one calendar event.
- `list_calendar_events`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's calendar events.
- `list_character_contact_labels`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's contact labels.
- `list_character_contacts`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's contacts.
- `list_character_mail`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's recent mail headers, optionally filtered by label and paged backwards via a mail ID cursor.
- `list_character_mail_lists`: List the mailing lists a logged-in EVE Online character is subscribed to.
- `list_character_notification_contacts`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's contact-standing notifications.
- `list_character_notifications`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's notifications.
- `list_corporation_contact_labels`: List a corporation's contact labels, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_contacts`: List a corporation's contacts, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `remove_character_contacts`: Remove contacts from a character's contact list — this deletes contacts on EVE's server.
- `respond_calendar_event`: Respond to a calendar event invite (accepted/declined/tentative) — this changes your RSVP status on EVE's server.
- `send_character_mail`: Send a new mail as a logged-in EVE Online character. This changes state on EVE's server.
- `update_character_contacts`: Update the standing/label/watched status of existing contacts — this changes state on EVE's server.
- `update_character_mail`: Update the read status and/or labels of one of a logged-in EVE Online character's mails. This changes state on EVE's server.

## Fleets and fittings

Fleet management and saved ship fittings.

- `create_character_fitting`: Save a new ship fitting for a logged-in character — this creates a new fitting on EVE's server.
- `create_fleet_squad`: Create a new squad within a fleet wing — this changes state on EVE's server.
- `create_fleet_wing`: Create a new wing in a fleet — this changes state on EVE's server.
- `delete_character_fitting`: Delete one of a logged-in character's saved ship fittings — this deletes the fitting on EVE's server.
- `delete_fleet_squad`: Delete a fleet squad — this changes state on EVE's server.
- `delete_fleet_wing`: Delete a fleet wing — this changes state on EVE's server.
- `get_character_fleet`: Get a logged-in EVE Online character's current fleet membership.
- `get_fleet`: Get a fleet's settings, using a logged-in character's fleet membership to authorize.
- `invite_fleet_member`: Invite a character into a fleet — this changes state on EVE's server.
- `kick_fleet_member`: Remove a member from a fleet — this changes state on EVE's server.
- `list_character_fittings`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's saved ship fittings.
- `list_fleet_members`: List a fleet's members, using a logged-in character's fleet membership to authorize.
- `list_fleet_wings`: List a fleet's wings and their nested squads, using a logged-in character's fleet membership to authorize.
- `move_fleet_member`: Move a fleet member to a new role, wing, or squad — this changes state on EVE's server.
- `rename_fleet_squad`: Rename a fleet squad — this changes state on EVE's server.
- `rename_fleet_wing`: Rename a fleet wing — this changes state on EVE's server.
- `update_fleet`: Update a fleet's settings — this changes state on EVE's server.

## Activities and cosmetics

Freelance jobs, corporation projects, mercenary dens and tactical operations, skyhooks, SKINR and the Paragon Hub.

- `get_character_freelance_job_participation`: Get a logged-in character's contribution to a freelance job.
- `get_character_mercenary_den`: Get full detail on one of the given character's mercenary dens: evolution stats, infomorph count, reinforcement timer, and attached skyhook.
- `get_corporation_project_contribution`: Get a character's contribution to a corporation project, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `get_corporation_project_detail`: Get the full details (configuration, progress, reward) of a corporation project, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `get_corporation_skyhook`: Get full detail on one of the given corporation's skyhooks: workforce, reagent stock, active/reinforcement state, and theft vulnerability window.
- `get_freelance_job`: Get the full details of a freelance job (public data, no character required).
- `get_mercenary_tactical_operation`: Get detail (dungeon type, mercenary den, state, expiry) for one mercenary tactical operation.
- `get_skinr`: Get a SKINR's full design: ship type, tier, and each cosmetic slot's nanocoating or pattern, with names (public data, no character required).
- `list_character_freelance_jobs`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's freelance jobs.
- `list_character_mercenary_dens`: List the given character's mercenary dens (includes resolved planet name).
- `list_character_paragon_hub_skinr_listings`: List the SKINR listings a logged-in character has posted on the Paragon Hub, including who each targets, cursor-paginated.
- `list_character_skinr_component_licenses`: List the SKINR component licenses (nanocoatings, patterns) a logged-in character owns, with names and remaining runs.
- `list_character_skinr_licenses`: List the SKINR (ship skin) licenses a logged-in character owns, with activated/unactivated counts.
- `list_corporation_freelance_job_participants`: List the participants in a corporation's freelance job, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_freelance_jobs`: List a corporation's freelance jobs, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_project_contributors`: List the contributors to a corporation project, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_projects`: List a corporation's projects, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_skyhooks`: List the given corporation's skyhooks (includes resolved planet name).
- `list_freelance_jobs`: List freelance jobs game-wide, optionally filtered by corporation (public data, no character required).
- `list_mercenary_tactical_operations`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's mercenary tactical operations.
- `list_paragon_hub_skinr_listings`: Browse the SKINR listings publicly available on the Paragon Hub, with ISK or PLEX prices, cursor-paginated (public data, no character required).
- `list_paragon_hub_skinr_listings_for_alliance`: Browse the Paragon Hub SKINR listings visible to an alliance, using a logged-in character to authorize, cursor-paginated.
- `list_paragon_hub_skinr_listings_for_character`: Browse the Paragon Hub SKINR listings visible to a logged-in character (listings other sellers targeted at it), cursor-paginated.
- `list_paragon_hub_skinr_listings_for_corporation`: Browse the Paragon Hub SKINR listings visible to a corporation, using a logged-in character to authorize, cursor-paginated.
- `list_raidable_skyhooks`: List upcoming raidable skyhooks (public data, no character scope required).

## Industry, mining and planets

Blueprints, industry jobs, mining, research agents and planetary industry.

- `get_character_planet`: Get the full colony layout (links, pins, routes) of one of a character's planets.
- `get_corporation_mining_observer_detail`: Get the mining ledger recorded by one of a corporation's mining observers, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `get_planetary_schematic`: Get a Planetary Interaction schematic's cycle time and name.
- `list_character_agents_research`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's agent research progress.
- `list_character_blueprints`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's blueprints.
- `list_character_industry_jobs`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's industry jobs.
- `list_character_mining`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's mining ledger.
- `list_character_planets`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's colonized planets (Planetary Interaction).
- `list_corporation_blueprints`: List a corporation's blueprints, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_customs_offices`: List a corporation's customs offices (POCOs), including tax rates and reinforcement schedule.
- `list_corporation_facilities`: List a corporation's facilities, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_industry_jobs`: List a corporation's industry jobs, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_mining_extractions`: List a corporation's moon mining extractions, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_mining_observers`: List a corporation's mining observers, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_industry_facilities`: List every industry facility in the game (public data, no character required).
- `list_industry_systems`: List industry cost indices for every solar system (public data, no character required).

## Corporations and alliances

Corporation and alliance details, members, roles, titles, structures and starbases. Most corporation tools need the character to hold the matching in-game roles.

- `get_access_list`: Get the name, description, and membership detail of one of a character's access lists.
- `get_alliance`: Get an alliance's name, ticker, founding info, and executor corporation (public data, no character required).
- `get_alliance_icons`: Get an alliance's icon URLs (public data, no character required).
- `get_corporation`: Get a corporation's public info (public data, no character required).
- `get_corporation_divisions`: Get a corporation's hangar and wallet division names, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `get_corporation_icons`: Get a corporation's icon URLs (public data, no character required).
- `get_corporation_members_limit`: Get a corporation's member limit, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `get_corporation_sovereignty_hub`: Get full detail on one of the given corporation's sovereignty hubs: reagent bay, power/workforce resources, upgrades, vulnerability window, and workforce transport configuration/state.
- `get_corporation_starbase`: Get detail for one of a corporation's starbases (POSes), using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_access_lists`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's structure/fleet access list IDs.
- `list_alliance_corporations`: List the corporation IDs currently in an alliance (public data, no character required).
- `list_alliances`: List every alliance ID currently in EVE Online (public data, no character required).
- `list_character_corporation_history`: List an arbitrary character's corporation history (public data, no character required).
- `list_corporation_alliance_history`: List a corporation's alliance membership history (public data, no character required).
- `list_corporation_container_logs`: List a corporation's container access logs, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_medals`: List a corporation's defined medals, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_medals_issued`: List medals a corporation has issued to its members, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_member_titles`: List a corporation's members' assigned title IDs, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_member_tracking`: List a corporation's member login/location/ship tracking data, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_members`: List a corporation's member character IDs, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_roles`: List a corporation's members' corp roles, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_roles_history`: List a corporation's role-change history, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_shareholders`: List a corporation's shareholders, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_sovereignty_hubs`: List the given corporation's sovereignty hubs (includes resolved solar system name).
- `list_corporation_standings`: List a corporation's standings toward NPC entities, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_starbases`: List a corporation's starbases (POSes), using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_structures`: List a corporation's structures, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_corporation_titles`: List a corporation's defined titles, using a logged-in character's roles to authorize.
- `list_npc_corporations`: List every NPC corporation ID in the game (public data, no character required).

## Character details

Skills, clones, implants, location, ship, standings, medals, roles and more.

- `get_character`: Get public info (name, corporation, bloodline, security status) about an arbitrary character (public data, no character required).
- `get_character_affiliations`: Resolve a set of character IDs to their current corporation/alliance/faction (public data, no character required).
- `get_character_attributes`: Get a logged-in EVE Online character's neural attributes (Charisma, Intelligence, Memory, Perception, Willpower) and remap history.
- `get_character_clones`: Get a logged-in EVE Online character's jump clones and home location.
- `get_character_cspa_cost`: Calculate the CSPA charge cost for a logged-in character to contact a set of target characters.
- `get_character_fatigue`: Get a logged-in EVE Online character's jump fatigue state.
- `get_character_location`: Get a logged-in EVE Online character's current solar system, and station or structure ID if docked/boarded.
- `get_character_online`: Get a logged-in EVE Online character's online status and login history.
- `get_character_portrait`: Get an arbitrary character's portrait URLs (public data, no character required).
- `get_character_roles`: Get a logged-in EVE Online character's corporation roles.
- `get_character_ship`: Get a logged-in EVE Online character's current ship.
- `list_character_implants`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's currently active implant type IDs.
- `list_character_medals`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's medals.
- `list_character_skill_queue`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's current skill training queue.
- `list_character_skills`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's trained skills, total skill points, and unallocated skill points.
- `list_character_standings`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's standings.
- `list_character_titles`: List a logged-in EVE Online character's corporation titles.
- `search_character`: Search for entities (characters, corporations, systems, etc.) matching a string, scoped to a logged-in character's search permissions.

## Server and ESI status

Tranquility status and ESI's own health, changelog and compatibility dates.

- `get_esi_changelog`: Get ESI's own changelog, keyed by date (public data, no character required).
- `get_esi_name`: Get ESI's current and historical names (public data, no character required).
- `get_esi_status`: Get the health status of every ESI route (public data, no character required).
- `get_status`: Get the current EVE Online server status: player count, version, start time, and VIP mode (public data, no character required).
- `list_esi_compatibility_dates`: List every compatibility date ESI currently accepts (public data, no character required).
